primaryGoal: Inspect sharing status/destination, output power, estimated remaining runtime, last stop reason and the latest observation timestamps.

dataSources.contract: vehicle_id and field wire parameters; signal_name translated to field; enveloped observations adapted to nullable numeric/text/bool values; abort signal forwarded; enabled only for a truthy vehicle; inherited REALTIME staleTime; no explicit polling or date bounds.

verifiedSourceFacts: internal\tesla\protomodel\signal_metadata_gen.go:1614-1615 classifies both numeric Powershare fields as UnitKindNone.
internal\tesla\normalize\normalize.go:138-145,221-234 passes non-overridden UnitKindNone fields through unchanged.
internal\tesla\units\conversions.go:186-193 fixed kilo-unit conversion set does not include PowershareInstantaneousPowerKW.
internal\api\signalscatalog\handler.go:195-202 returns the stored Value without physical conversion; useTelemetry.ts:555-569 performs numeric coercion, not unit conversion.
PowersharePage.tsx:90,93,125-134 assumes kW/h and multiplies by 1000/3600 for operational metric input.
units.conclusion: The inspected path does not establish canonical W/s for these fields. Vendor names alone are not an authoritative wire-unit contract. Existing page assumptions must not be silently replaced with W/s interpretation or compensated by a second conversion. Resolve authoritative source units and stored history semantics with the integration owner before changing numeric behavior.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Barrel still exports five older presentation panels while the mounted page consumes four modernization cards plus summary. Legacy and modern versions duplicate chart/session/stop/snapshot rendering; constants/helpers remain legitimate common dependencies.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use the current mounted renderer as owner; check remaining callers and preserve legacy behavioral tests before consolidating exports. Do not delete capabilities or transplant old components.

sourceFacts: PowersharePage.tsx:31-32,211-213,244 defines stacked default grids, three/two columns at xl and min-w-0 child containers.
RuntimeCard.tsx:47-56 wraps status/destination rows; StopReasonCard.tsx:24 wraps its badge/help.
SnapshotCard.tsx:57 preserves all three columns through the shared DataTable mobileColumns API.
ChartCard.tsx:18-21 delegates bounded chart sizing to placement policy.
responsive.verification: All prescribed viewports 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, actual container widths, mobile table overflow, long labels and 200% text are unverified.

sourceFacts: PowersharePage.tsx:149 supplies a localized refresh name; section aria-labels at 190,209,242.
TrendCard.tsx:37-47 supplies chart names and data-table columns.
RuntimeCard.tsx:49-50 and StopReasonCard.tsx:25 retain text beside status color.
FadeIn.tsx:25-34 delegates reduced-motion preference and skips initial animation when reduced.
accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus, chart/table tool interactions, screen reader, touch target sizes, forced colors, composed contrast, RTL and OS reduced motion unverified; source ARIA is not acceptance.

preserved: Independent initial loading/error/empty handling for trends, runtime and stop reason.
Retained data survives refresh failure through fatalError rather than raw query error.
Stale/offline notices are placed next to retained trend, stop and snapshot content.
Unknown/nonfinite numbers remain null; actual zero is preserved.

issues.detail: Summary omits loading although snapshotLoading is calculated at 103-104. ChargingSummaryBrief defaults loading=false (line 14), so initial requests show 'No source measurements' instead of initial loading.
issues.fix: Supply source-aware initial loading to the summary without suppressing retained metrics or independently resolved neighbors.

issues.detail: Summary retained flag checks only combined status==='stale'. combineDataStates returns 'partial' for mixed stale/healthy sources (dataState.ts:316-325), so a partly retained summary can be labeled fully available by ChargingSummaryBrief's value-count status logic. runtimeState trust is also not passed to RuntimeCard; generic page metadata does not establish each metric's trust.
issues.fix: Carry actual contributing stale/blocked/partial state and source-specific availability into summary status/context and runtime notice; retain all values and independent retry.

issues.detail: 'Live Session' and the no-live-session explanation at line 43 describe historical latest observations as live/current despite no bounded freshness validation or live polling. Page explicitly marks all five sources historical at 54-58.
issues.fix: Use recorded-session wording and observation freshness evidence; absence of readings must not assert session inactivity. Preserve status, destination, both bars and peak context.

issues.detail: Snapshot constructs five placeholder rows even when every successful source is empty; SnapshotCard's DataTable emptyMessage (line 63) therefore cannot describe all-empty telemetry. Unknown cells are preserved, but missing-source context is absent.
issues.fix: Keep all five identities and their unknown placeholders; add explicit no-observations/unavailable context rather than deleting the table.

issues.detail: Null selection uses the same select-vehicle EmptyState during initial fleet loading, fleet failure and truly empty fleet. useSelectedVehicle internally reads useVehicles but exposes no query-state distinction to the page.
issues.fix: Preserve header-owned vehicle selection while distinguishing fleet loading/failure/empty through the existing vehicle query contract; show actionable retry for fleet failure.

sourceFacts: Mounted page/cards use shared surfaces and typography; targeted prohibited-pattern scan found no inline styles, raw controls/tables, direct chart/map/motion library imports, fixed-white/gray/neon text or literal hex in mounted TSX scope.
Modern trends and bars reuse useChartPalette instead of legacy literal POWER_COLOR/HOURS_COLOR; do not reset saved explicit chart palettes.
visualIssues.verification: Actual palette restraint, hierarchy, light/dark theme composition, clipping and contrast unverified. Legacy constants remain exported but are not the mounted trend colors.

architectureIssues.detail: RuntimeCard, StopReasonCard and SnapshotCard import LayoutCard from the implementation sub-barrel '@/components/layout/layout-reference' instead of the canonical category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Import the existing LayoutCard from '@/components/layout'; do not add another card wrapper.

architectureIssues.detail: Canonical power/duration StatMetric input is synthesized by scaling observations assumed to be kW/h. Metadata and inspected normalization do not establish canonical raw W/s for these fields. This is an integration contract gap, not evidence that all readings should now be divided by 1000/3600.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must establish authoritative vendor units, normalization and historical payload semantics; preserve current source values during audit and require explicit unit contract before changing adapters or display conversions.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart export/data-table projection discards TrendPoint.ts and keeps only formatted time labels. The 48 readings can span multiple dates, so equal clock labels do not uniquely identify observations in exported evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve full timestamp in export and accessible data rows using shared date formatting, without changing chronological order, source values or chart series.

architectureIssues.detail: humanizeEnum uses signal-name prefixes, whereas metadata defines distinct PowershareState/PowershareTypeStatus/PowershareStopReasonStatus prefixes. Fallback can produce 'State Enabled'/'Status Home' rather than intended labels, and known enum display is not localized.
architectureIssues.fix: Use verified enum-prefix metadata and localized known enum labels while preserving raw unknown enum text and current severity meaning.

priority.rationale: Resolve unit contract and historical-versus-live trust before presentation adoption; P2 source-state, enum-label and export clarity; P3 canonical imports and duplicate consolidation.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Verified Powershare observation physical-unit contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Explicit unit semantics for PowershareInstantaneousPowerKW and PowershareHoursLeft; distinguish vendor raw, stored history and display input; nullable/nonfinite/zero cases; preserve signal identities and cache values.
requiredSharedChanges.disposition: Integration investigation required, no shared mutation authorized by this audit.

actions: Snapshot sorting and stable table identity charging:powershare-signals
Header vehicle selection and URL scope
dataBehavior: Five signal identities and all observation timestamps
Limit 1 text / 48 numeric samples, newest observations rendered chronologically in trends
No date-range promise: /powershare has range=false, vehicle=true in workspaceScope.ts; no duplicate selector required
Null and nonfinite are unknown, measured zero remains zero
Source/raw values and query keys, cancellation, enablement and inherited cache policies
